risk_summary: The disclosure presents strong demand and recovery prospects but acknowledges material exposure to supply-chain disruptions, labor and material inflation, execution challenges, and macroeconomic uncertainty. Forward-looking statements rely heavily on expectations and qualitative assurances, with limited quantified sensitivity analysis in the excerpt. Liquidity and covenant compliance are stated positively, although debt servicing remains dependent on future operating cash flow and external conditions.
